_about: 2-Propanol (1) + Acetonitrile (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-propanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-propanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: W. Zhu, L. Qing, B. Liu, X. Cai, Z. Fan, Effect of imidazolium-based ionic liquid on vapor-liquid equilibria of 2-propanol + acetonitrile binary system at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 409 (2016) 383-387
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 7, 8. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0085. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.22 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
